messages:
incident-bot: P1 - Inference stream errors detected in us-west-2b (region: us-west-2, AZ:b). Pager opened: INC-20260317-wo2b. Link: https://internal.incidents/r/INC-20260317-wo2b :rotating_light:

sylvia: seeing 502/stream_eof on gRPC -> model shards in us-west-2b. Latency spike from ~60ms -> 800ms. Affected ~15% of requests.

marc: metrics -> https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/inference?orgId=1 showing resolver timeouts and pod restarts. Logs:
```
2026-03-17T02:04:12Z resolver.go:89 resolver query timeout: dial tcp 10.0.0.2:53: i/o timeout
2026-03-17T02:04:15Z stream.go:211 grpc: stream error: code = Unavailable desc = connection reset
```

ops-lex: VPC dns (169.254.169.x) showing SERVFAIL spikes. Route53 resolver metrics align.

oncall-jordan: I'm on it. Mitigation plan:
1) mark us-west-2b degraded in routing config
2) enable AZ failover to us-west-2a for inference
3) scale fallback capacity + enable stateless model variant in other AZs
Doing now.

oncall-jordan: running reroute:
```bash
redwoodctl routing set-priority --region us-west-2 --from az=b --to az=a --percent 100
```

incident-bot: automated rollback guard tripped: redirect applied, healthchecks still failing for 2% of pods due to sticky connections.

rita: opening runbook task: check KV cache population & proxy sticky sessions. Recommend TTL downshift to 30s to accelerate DNS rollout.

ops-lex: Route53 policy updated, TTL=30s and health-based routing enabled. Done.

sylvia: customer-impact: Dedicated customers in us-west-2b saw streaming failures and higher latency; most requests retried and succeeded. Two customers reported sustained error rates; CS alerted.

customer-success-amy: I've messaged both customers with a heads-up and ETA ~30m. Will push updates as we know more.

marc: disabling LB session affinity to avoid sticky sockets:
```hcl
resource 'aws_lb_target_group' 'inference' {
  stickiness {
    enabled = false
  }
}
```

oncall-jordan: scaling up us-west-2a capacity + enabling fallback quantized model:
`redwoodctl capacity scale --region us-west-2 --az a --gpu g5 --count +8`
`redwoodctl model set-fallback --model rdx-3b-quant --enable`

ops-lex: cross-AZ egress rising, monitoring cost impact :grimacing:

incident-bot: update: ~80% of traffic shifted to us-west-2a, error rates trending down toward baseline.

oncall-jordan: handing off to rita for follow-up and postmortem. stepping out for 15m.

rita: taking over. Will continue monitoring and assemble timeline. Preliminary suspected cause: resolver scaling regression after DHCP option set change. Need infra logs to confirm.

eng-runtime-lead: noted — I'll capture KV cache warmup steps and evaluate pre-warm during failover; also review VPC resolver config.

customer-success-amy: customers confirmed mitigations are working, appreciate the quick response.

oncall-jordan: ack :thumbsup:

rita: filing INC-20260317-wo2b-PM with timeline, commands, and CS notes.

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated. Last update time: 1729005050
